verses.1: In those days, there was no king in Israel. And in those days, the Dane tried to get a share of the land, since up until that time, no one else had ever been able to take control of any part of Israel’s land.
verses.2: And the sons of Dan sent five men from their families. These were men from the tribe of Zebulun and from Issachar. They were sent to explore the land. They were told, “Go and explore the land.” So they went to Mount Ebal and stayed there.
verses.3: They went with Micah’s house. They recognized the voice of the young boy, and they refused to go there. They said to him, “Who brought you here? What are you doing here? And where are you going?”
verses.4: And he said to them, “This and that did Michael do for me. He hired me, and I became his servant.”
verses.5: And they said to him, “Please ask God to tell us whether our path we are following will be successful.”
verses.6: And the priest said to them, “Go and make haste. May Jehovah bless your path along which you will walk.”
verses.7: And the five men went and came to Yeshua. They saw that the people around him were calm and peaceful, just like those who are under judgment by God. There was no chaos or trouble on the earth. The prisoners and the outcasts were all safe, and they had nothing to do with humans.
verses.8: And they came to their relatives, Zaraha and Eshtol. They said to them, “What are you doing here?”
verses.9: And they said, “Come, let’s go up onto it. For we have seen that the land is very good. And you should not be discouraged from going up onto it and taking possession of it.”
verses.10: As you enter, you will come upon a people who are fearful. The land is vast and wide, as if it has been given by God into your hands. It’s a place where nothing can be hidden from anyone.
verses.11: And they departed from there, from the family of Dan in Zerah. And from Ashthael, six thousand men who were armed with weapons.
verses.12: And they went up and camped in the forests of Judah. Therefore, they called that place “Machaneh Dan” until today. Now, after camping in those forests…
verses.13: And they passed through Mount Efrathi, and came to the house of Micah.
verses.14: And the five men who were going to stand on the ground said to each other, “We know that there are those who are evil and cruel in these houses. Now, tell us what we should do.”
verses.15: And they left Shammah and went to the house of the young lad, Levi. They asked him for forgiveness.
verses.16: And six thousand men were confined there, as weapons for their battles. They stood at the entrance of the gate that leads to Dan.
verses.17: And the five men who were going to stand on the ground arrived. They took the spears, the shields, and all the other weapons. The priest stood at the entrance of the gate. Six women were also there, each carrying a weapon from war.
verses.18: And these people came to Micah’s house. They took the utensils used for burning incense, as well as the other offerings. Then the priest asked them, “What are you doing?”
verses.19: And they said to him, “Put your hand over your face, and go with us. May you become our father and a good priest. You can either be a priest in one man’s house, or you can be a priest who serves the Lord and his family in Israel.”
verses.20: And the priest was pleased. He took the incense, the fragrant spices, and the golden altar, and he went before the people.
verses.21: And they turned around and went away. They placed the tent and all their belongings in front of them.
verses.22: Many people fled from the house of Micah. The people who lived in the houses near Micah also cried out and touched the children of Dan.
verses.23: And they called out to the children of Dan. They turned around, and said to Michah, “What are you doing here? You’ve come here in a hurry.”
verses.24: And he said to the gods whom I had created: “Take them away from me! And also take along the priest. What more do I have to do? And what will you say to me now?”
verses.25: And the sons of Dan said to him, “Do not listen to your voice among us, for those people from Marai Nefesh will harm you. You have brought your own soul and the souls of your household into danger.”
verses.26: And the sons of Dan went their separate ways. Michah saw that they were much stronger than him. So he fled and returned to his house.
verses.27: And they took away what Moses had done, and also the priest who was with him. They came upon the people who were peaceful and confident. They attacked them in battle, and they burned down the city with fire.
verses.28: And there is no one who can save her from her distance. There is nothing they have to say to her. She is in a place where there’s no hope of escape. They built the city there, and they settled down in it.
verses.29: And they named the city “Dan”, after their ancestor Dan, who was born in Israel. But originally, the city’s name was “Rah.”
verses.30: And the sons of Dan built the altar. Yehonatan, son of Geršom, son of Manasseh, was one of them. His sons became priests who served in the court of the Danite people, until the time when the land was conquered.
verses.31: And they placed before them the altar that Moses had made, which he used every day in the house of God.
